note: What a server sends to fill in the numbers a client shows beside a unit's spells. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.note: How many sets of numbers follow. A client ignores the whole message where they do not all fit in it.

fields.name: entries
fields.note: The sets themselves.

items.name: entry
items.note: The numbers a client shows beside one of a unit's spells.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit whose spell this is. A client skips the set where it does not hold the unit.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Where the numbers go: 120 and up is the summoner slot this less 120, 60 to 119 the spell slot this less 60. 0 to 59 change nothing a client is seen to show.

fields.name: values
fields.note: The numbers themselves, one place each.
